name: Fannaria Amm
source:
From: Heavy Metal L-Gaim
A girl travelling with Daba, Amm was a playhouse actress hired by bandit leader Miyama Lilen. After falling head-over-heels in love with Daba, however, she decided to tag along at the team's behest.
